property_summary: For any actor and any funding amount, calling withdrawAll must never decrease the contract's balance (only the owner may withdraw and any other caller reverts), but the mutant lets any caller drain the entire balance to zero.

For any non-owner actor, a call to withdrawAll must revert (only the owner may drain the contract), and the contract's balance must be unchanged; the mutant drops onlyOwner so a non-owner's withdrawAll succeeds and drains the balance.

For any amount v the owner withdraws (with v <= contract balance), the contract's balance must decrease by exactly v; the mutant always transfers only 1 wei, leaving address(c).balance == v-1 instead of 0 for any v > 1.

For any admissible amount v (>=2 wei, with contract funded and owner withdrawing), the recipient's balance increases by exactly v and address(c).balance decreases by exactly v; the mutant always transfers only 1 wei, so the recipient's delta is 1 instead of v.

For any amount the owner withdraws (with the contract funded with exactly that amount), the full amount is transferred out: the recipient's balance rises by exactly amount and address(c).balance drops to 0; the mutant always sends 1 wei, so for any amount > 1 the recipient's delta is 1 instead of amount.

For any admissible _value >= 2 wei, if the contract is funded with exactly _value wei, a completed withdraw(_value) must drain the entire balance so address(c).balance becomes 0; the mutant always transfers only 1 wei, leaving _value - 1 wei behind for every _value > 1.

For any amount v (>=1 wei) sent to a codeless, non-c recipient EOA, a completed c.withdraw(v) by the owner transfers exactly v wei out of c (leaving address(c).balance == 0 when c held exactly v); the mutant always sends 1 wei, leaving v-1 wei behind for any v>1.

For any deposit of at least 1 wei sent through the fallback, the owner's withdrawAll must drain the contract's entire balance to exactly 0; the mutant always leaves 1 wei behind after withdrawAll.
Only the owner can withdraw: when the test contract is the owner, withdrawAll succeeds and drains the contract's balance to zero.
